notes.title: Post Release Plans
notes.notes:
Jelly Blocks 1.0 goes live tomorrow (April 11th), but work on it continues.

In the next couple of weeks updates will include:

 Adding a controls summary to the game UI. Jelly Blocks is supposed to be a super simple to play game and some people find the two stick controls counter intuitive.
 Graphics that visually indicate the blocks freeze mechanic
 A fix for the annoying blocks overlays are slightly off center bug
 Fixes for user reported bug
 Internal updates to support new game modes


In the next couple of months, planned updates are:

 Steam achievements
 Steam cloud saves
 New game modes


Thanks for playing!
